title: The speed of things
html:
Sometimes things seem to take forever to happen and then it’s all go: things are happening and you are a little bit out of control. Just like Keanu Reeves steering a runaway bus in the movie, Speed.

Perhaps this is why Albert Einstein said, “People love chopping wood. In this activity one immediately sees results.” I feel sure this is because something is happening, in a controlled way.

For example: The past month leading up to Lauren leaving the country has taken forever, and now she has gone it seems time is speeding up, and I have a list of things to do before she comes home. I know that if I muck around, the time will disappear and nothing will have been done.

This can happen daily if you’re not careful. You put something off that you don’t really enjoy, to instead do something that you do enjoy and, before you know it, the day is gone, and the thing you needed to do, that moves you ahead, still isn’t done.

This is not procrastination, this is some strange anomaly (in the time space continuum?) that keeps you on your toes and makes everyday both fun and a challenge.


Have a great week and consider doing the things that don’t light your fire first, so that you can relax and enjoy the things you love to do.
